findings.claim: Local encryption and authenticated updates use exactly Vault.key and luxnix-master through Ansible VaultLib; no ambient identity discovery or plaintext temporary files. Host exports use the unique registered PSK identity; unknown, duplicate, or master-labeled host identities fail closed.

Vault.load_dir honors explicit key/directory arguments instead of persisted paths. Vault.validate_local_key checks the private nonempty master key and decrypts all metadata-listed secrets before caller writes.
Admin validation uses the explicit master identity and strict password input loading. Legacy ciphertext fails with an explicit migration requirement.

Explicit per-file migration authenticates legacy ciphertext using one specified key/label, verifies newly encrypted master ciphertext, refuses existing output, and retains all source ciphertext, keys, and metadata. It does not publish a vault or exports.

gaps: No real vault ciphertext, production keys, or hosts were inspected or changed. Controlled custodian migration, restore, and host adoption acceptance remain required; local_key_contract readiness is not established by source tests alone.

Migration is per-file and intentionally non-destructive. Operator must inventory all legacy ciphertext and exact key mappings, retain encrypted backups and old keys, stage every verified copy in a new vault, review/update copied vault.yml absolute secret paths, validate the complete new vault, then switch as one reviewed operation before exporting. No automatic mixed-key fallback or metadata path rewrite is provided.

Existing keys that grant group/other permissions now fail; the custodian must review and correct private key handling before operations. Missing existing keys must be recovered rather than regenerated.

Earlier broader run had one obsolete validator subprocess mock failure; root adapted that regression after the direct VaultLib implementation. Parent owns final combined suite verification; this worker ran only focused integration additions in its final review turn.
